nom: Drunk Elephant C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed outcomes: some say it does not irritate, sting, cause redness or itching and works well despite sensitivity, while one warns the product is very potent and 'not for the sensitive skin types' and must be spaced out from exfoliation or retinol.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to over 60 report brighter, firmer, smoother-looking skin and reduced neck or forehead wrinkles, though one notes wrinkles specifically did not improve despite better tone and dryness.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the product keeps her face matte all day.
segments.dry: One reviewer reports the product dried out and left her skin chalky, and another describes dry, red, flaky, raw skin with a burning sensation after a single use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, plumper, more even-toned skin and less visible forehead or neck wrinkles within weeks to a month; one long-term user says wrinkles never improved despite other gains.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it locks in moisture and leaves skin soft and hydrated for hours; two others report the opposite, describing dry, chalky, or raw skin after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer explicitly notes no redness or stinging; another reports a burning sensation with red, flaky skin after a single application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes burning on contact with dry, flaky, raw skin, suggesting barrier disruption for at least this user.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of sun spots, dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and melasma over weeks to months; one reviewer says vitamin C in general has worsened brown spots on her face and limits use to her neck.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers dealing with acne, acne scarring, or acne spots report fading scars, clearer skin, and helpful results within one to several weeks; no dissent on this concern is present.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the product keeps oily skin matte throughout the day.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue after application

extraits.texte: I applied this ONCE, it left a white powdery residue when it dried, even though I made sure the solution and the powder completely dissolved. Burning sensation upon contact and dry red flaky raw skin after.

The only reason I bought this is because it came with a midi set and I love the other two products in the set. My facial skin hates Vitamin C; no matter what form I use it does the opposite of what it's supposed to do (most of the brown spots on my face are from using vitamin C), so I'm only using it in my neck. Not a fan of the watery, sticky texture, but the worst thing is the smell. It smells exactly like bacon, which I don't eat, so I *really* don't like smelling it on my neck. I'll review again if it actually works on my neck. At this point it's too early to tell.

After months of trying to find a more affordable dupe for this product I caved and subscribed because my sensitive skin combined with the results I was trying to achieve I just couldn't find anything to match the results I was getting with this. The product instantly absorbs into my skin and I can see immediate results in the smoothness, plumpness and overall more even-toned appearance of my face. My forehead wrinkles are less deep and do not appear as much. It truly does make everything firmer! The only thing I'm not a fan of is the bottle because it is hard to get all of the product out once it gets low and you have to be careful using the pump so it doesn't spray and waste it. But other than that I just can't say no to it!

extraits.titre: It seems to really lock in moister
extraits.texte: I'm in my 50's and my skin has been changing a lot in the last few years (age spots, wrinkles, dryness, etc.). I've tried A LOT of different products. I've loved that this really makes my skin feel soft for hours, particularly when used in conjunction with Protini Polypeptide Firming Moisturizer - it seems to lock in moister all day. I've noticed my skin tone and dryness have improved (however, wrinkles just never seem to get better no matter what I try).

I've been using for about 1 1/2 weeks and this product has already brighten and toned my skin. It's very powerful and not for the sensitive skins types. So if I exfoliate my skin, I will wait a day before using this to prevent over tingling. If I am using Retinol A I also skin a day or two and rotate the use of this product. You have to be careful using this product and know how to and when to use. The worst thing is that because its very potent, it smells like lighter fluid a bit but it ok with me because I didn't choose the product for the smell of it, I choose for the results I knew I'd get.

Ive tried a bunch of vitamin C products for acne scarring, but this is the only one that seemed to work, and fast! The smell is obvious since there's no added fragrances. Vit C smells funky because thats how it smells. The formulation is wonderful, and definitely something to praise. I'm very happy I took the chance on this product, since this was my first Drunk Elephant purchase. My acne scarring is fading, and I feel more confident in my skin!
I use this daily, as my AM regimen and my face is still mate, throughout the day!
